Overview

This ultrasonic sensor bracket is listed as an accessory for ultrasonic volume sensing on geological mud-logging instruments. It provides mechanical support for the ultrasonic transducer used in pit or tank volume measurement.

Only the name, model/SKU and category note published on the supplier catalogue are retained below. Accuracy, range, output and other performance figures are not stated on that listing and are not invented here.

Configured specifications

Applications

Typical use is as a replacement or expansion accessory on a mud-logging unit wireless sensor suite. Confirm mechanical fit, power, and interface compatibility with the installed logging system before ordering.

Inquire for the datasheet, wiring or interface notes, and compatibility with your existing mud logging unit.
